nonAuthoritativeControls.reason: Search and pagination inspect a person's access in one application.
Resource selection requests an authorized review of people and granting paths.
Subject, action and coordinate select a read-only access explanation.
Person search and workspace-administrator filters request authorized reports.
The picker returns an eligible saved-view reference to the role and scope editor. AuthorizationAssignments owns the reviewed change.
Selecting a platform template proposes an adoption to the registered authorization editor, which owns the reviewed change and outcome.
Global search and task filters do not create a business or configuration draft.
Workspace search, status filters and route selection are presentation-only controls. Business edits remain in the registered metadata editors and all transitions use the shared unsaved-work guard.

MetadataDimensionCreateRows owns the dimension and mapping draft. Choices are transient to one server review. LayoutReplacementRequest retains the exact admitted program when the outcome is unconfirmed.
Activity search and paging only select among authorized read-only workflow records; no business draft is created.
Inventory filtering only; authored Python is owned by the registered PythonDefinitionEditor and transitions use the shared unsaved-work guard.
Application selection and destructive lifecycle confirmation operate on an exact server-prepared target; no editable business draft is created. Retry identity grants no server authority.

Shared controlled source-code renderer only. Each editable parent owns and registers the authoritative draft; read-only callers cannot create one, and this component never persists a separate business draft.

Read-only worked-coordinate selection and current persisted descriptions. These inputs only choose an authorized read; no model description, business fact, policy, calculation or draft is authored or persisted.
Scenario, coordinate and display selections drive an authorized comparison read. The controls do not author or publish a scenario, a business fact or a saved view.
The dimension and member selections request a worked read of the current attribute and its source. No attribute value or member definition is drafted or saved.

sharedControls.reason: Role and scope edits mark the common authorization draft dirty. The parent editor owns review, commit, recovery and the navigation guard.
Selects an eligible group from the governed workspace read. The application creator owns and reviews the resulting creation draft.

Shared authorized dimension/member scope editor. Build Schedules, Data Export, Data Load and Planning Policies own the exact submitted scope and register the unsaved workflow; this control only returns a typed scalar member map and never persists or submits independently.

Shared controlled parameter renderer. The listed parent editors own the submitted values and register unsaved work; transient input text in this renderer never grants server authority or persists a separate business draft.
Selects a published definition and shows its current review. GenericWorkflow owns confirmation, admission and the registered signed start request, including recovery after interruption.
